subject: Deliverable: Onboarding & Separation Logs + Redacted Training Roster for SOC 2 Scope
messages:
From: Eleanor Bates <eleanor.bates@greenfield-analytics.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: audit@greenfield-analytics.com
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 scoping: onboarding & offboarding artifacts request

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for the quick sync earlier. As part of scoping our SOC 2 Type II review, we need a short bundle showing personnel onboarding and separation controls for a sampling window (Jan 1, 2025 — Oct 31, 2026). Specifically: 

- A CSV export of new starter records (hire date, role, manager) with PII redacted.
- A training roster showing mandatory security training completions and timestamps (redacted SSNs/emails OK).
- A summary file indicating background-check dispositions (pass/active) for the sample.
- Offboarding/separation log for any leavers in the sample with proof of access revocation (screenshot or ticket id acceptable).

Can you confirm: 1) whether you can provide redacted artifacts, 2) an estimated delivery by end of next week, and 3) whether any of this is stored in a system that requires an export request (e.g., Workday or a third-party vendor).

If possible please deliver a one-page readme with redaction approach and any limitations for the auditor.

Best,
Eleanor
Eleanor Bates
Lead Auditor, Greenfield Analytics
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Eleanor Bates <eleanor.bates@greenfield-analytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 scoping: onboarding & offboarding artifacts request

Hi Eleanor — thanks for outlining this. Confirming we can provide a redacted bundle that meets the ask. Quick notes on scope and approach: 

- Source systems: onboarding_log_export.csv and separation_manifest are exported from our HRIS (Workday) via admin export; training_roster is from our LMS (LearningStream); background_checks_summary is an internal consolidated CSV produced by People Ops (we retain vendor disposition only).
- Redaction policy: we will remove full legal names and PII, leave employee IDs (internal hashed ids), manager and role data intact, and replace emails with domain masked tokens (e.g., user@redacted.example). Date fields will be provided in YYYY-MM-DD format.
- Delivery ETA: draft bundle for your review by COB Wed 2026-12-02. Finalized redactions and signed readme by Thu 2026-12-03 if no follow-ups.

Attachments planned: onboarding_log_export.csv (sample window), training_roster_redacted.pdf (scanned redacted export), background_checks_summary.csv (vendor disposition only), separation_manifest_redacted.pdf (access revocation ticket references).

I'll attach a short readme explaining redaction choices when I send the bundle. Looping in Marissa (People Ops) for the actual exports and Grace for records of access revocations. Jonas is on the thread for any escalation.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

---
Reply below if you need any changes to the sample fields we provide.
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Eleanor Bates <eleanor.bates@greenfield-analytics.com>
Cc: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:17:00 -08:00
Subject: Export bundle (draft) + readme for SOC2 sample

Hi all — attaching the draft exports for the sampling window you requested. Key callouts in the readme: 

- background_checks_summary.csv: contains candidate_id (hashed), vendor_result=(pass|exception), check_date (YYYY-MM-DD). No PII included.
- onboarding_log_export.csv: contains hire_date, role, manager_id (hashed), location, and internal_emp_id (hashed). Full names and personal emails removed.
- training_roster_redacted.pdf: LMS export with name column redacted to hash, training timestamps preserved.
- separation_manifest_redacted.pdf: list of leavers plus access revocation ticket ids (IAM-XXX or Okta tickets). We included one sample access-revocation screenshot referenced in the manifest (screenshot_access_revocation_20261104.png).

Attachments (attached to this email): background_checks_summary.csv; training_roster_redacted.pdf; onboarding_log_export.csv; separation_manifest_redacted.pdf; readme_onboarding-redaction.txt

Notes / limitations: 
- We do not provide historical SSN or DOB fields for redaction reasons; vendor background dispositions suffice for the auditor.
- Access revocation artifacts are exported from ticketing (Jira) and Okta logs; screenshots are redacted to remove ticket assignees.

If you need the original (unredacted) artifacts under an NDA or direct channel, we can coordinate via an encrypted SFTP transfer and DPA-safe protocol.

Marissa Cole
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: background_checks_summary.csv (csv), training_roster_redacted.pdf (pdf), onboarding_log_export.csv (csv), separation_manifest_redacted.pdf (pdf), readme_onboarding-redaction.txt (txt)

The readme explains redaction choices clearly and the manifest maps revocations to ticket IDs (we can spot-check those). That will help our evidence matrix.

If you can add that note and resend the readme (or just post the update to the Drive link you listed), we're good to close this request on our side.
